name: 58237 · Grafton, ND
findings: ZIP 58237 (Grafton) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58237 (Grafton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 58237 (Grafton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
